item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00469","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C06","C02","C01"],"selected_candidate_label":"C06","confidence":0.88,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C06 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Both directives delegate presidential fact-finding authority concerning facilities needed in areas affected by defense activities, use the distinctive formula empowering an official to act “without the approval, ratification, or other action of the President,” and coordinate the delegated findings through defense-mobilization and other specialized officials. The child substantially adapts that machinery to statutory findings concerning school facilities. C02 and C01 strongly parallel the delegation formula, with C02 also naming the same recipient department, but neither matches C06's combination of delegated findings, defense-affected facilities, and interagency administrative controls.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare is hereby authorized and empowered, without the approval, ratification, or other action of the President, to make the findings authorized to be made by the President","parent_excerpt":"The Director of Defense Mobilization is hereby designated and empowered to perform, without the approval, ratification, or other action of the president, the function vested in the President ... of making the findings","explanation":"The child closely follows C06's distinctive delegation-of-presidential-findings formulation."},{"child_excerpt":"the findings authorized to be made by the President under section 305 (a) (3) of the act ... relating to the construction of school facilities in areas affected by Federal activities","parent_excerpt":"determining critical defense-housing areas and ... making the findings relative to such determinations required by section 101(b) of the said Act","explanation":"Both delegate statutory findings concerning construction or facilities needs in areas affected by federal defense activity."},{"child_excerpt":"the Secretary ... shall follow and be bound by the recommendations of the Director of the Office of Defense Mobilization ... and ... the Secretary of Labor","parent_excerpt":"the Federal Security administrator or his delegate shall determine the general layout, size, and special design features ... [and officials] shall ... consult with the Secretary of Commerce ... [or] obtain the approval of the Surgeon General","explanation":"Both employ a primary delegate whose exercise of facilities-related functions is constrained or informed by designated specialist officials, showing parallel interagency machinery."}]}
